decisions.rationale: Opp Mega is Blastoise-Mega. Lead Politoed+Grimmsnarl: Drizzle auto-sets rain, Grimmsnarl Prankster Fake Out flinches the faster threat (Sneasler/Manectric) T1, then Prankster Reflect cuts Sneasler's Close Combat to survivable range for Archaludon. Back Archaludon sweeps under screens with rain-boosted Electro Shot vs Blastoise/Pelipper; Staraptor Intimidate+Brave Bird (2x on Sneasler, 85-248%) revenge-kills and handles Manectric with Close Combat. Must remove Manectric before Archaludon's Electr
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant), Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(Mega Launcher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key interactions: Manectric Lightning Rod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—must KO or force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Sneasler Close Combat 63-131% to Archaludon (possible OHKO); Reflect in doubles cuts ~33%, making it survivable. Staraptor Brave Bird 85-248% on Sneasler (likely OHKO). Houndoom Taunt cannot outspeed Grimmsnarl Prankster screens (+1 priority). Sinistcha TR at -7 priority can be stopped by Prankster Taunt. Opponent likely leads Pelipper+Sneasler or Pelipper+Manectric. Plan: screens into Archaludon sweep, Staraptor for Sneasler revenge. Game 1 plan: Politoed+Grimmsnarl lead, Archaludon+Staraptor back.

decisions.rationale: Lead Pelipper+Sneasler to win rain war (Damp Rock 8t vs Politoed 5t) and pressure Archaludon with Close Combat (2x SE Fighting). Sneasler 172 Spe moves before Archaludon (105-137) and Rock Slide threatens Noivern/Staraptor for SE. Back Houndoom+Manectric: Houndoom Flash Fire pivots on Fire and Dark Pulse covers neutrally; Manectric Scarf outspeeds Noivern (258 vs 192 max) and Thunderbolt handles Flying/Water. Mega Blastoise cleans late with rain-boosted Hydro Pump.
decisions.notebook: Opp team: Politoed Drizzle 5t rain, Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb weak to Fighting, Noivern Infiltrator ExpertBelt 157-192 Spe, Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay screens FakeOut, Staraptor Intimidate Sash 132-167 Spe, Garganacl PurifyingSalt WideGuard. Rain war: Pelipper DampRock 8t beats Politoed 5t. Archaludon is biggest threat - Sneasler CC is answer despite Stamina Def boosts. Noivern outspeeds Sneasler/Houndoom - Manectric Scarf is the check (Thunderbolt neutral 1x on Flying/Dragon but STAB + speed wins). Grimmsnarl screens + FakeOut disrupts - Sneasler PoisonJab threatens it (SE Poison on Dark/Fairy). Staraptor Intimidate weakens Sneasler but FocusSash means it dies to one hit. Garganacl PurifyingSalt ignores Ghost - Sinistcha ShadowBall walled, use MatchaGotcha or pivot. Mega Blastoise cleans late with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher boost.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 priority, guaranteed before Sneasler) flinches or forces Protect on the fastest threat. Weather Ball in rain (Water 100 BP, STAB+rain) chips Pelipper 26-63% vs Ice Beam's 21-51%. Grimmsnarl survives Hurricane (31-57%). Next turn: set up Reflect/Light Screen for Archaludon sweep plan.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant), Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(Mega Launcher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key interactions: Manectric Lightning Rod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—must KO or force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Sneasler Close Combat possible OHKO on Archaludon; Reflect cuts ~33% in doubles making survivable. Staraptor Brave Bird likely OHKOs Sneasler. Houndoom Taunt cannot outspeed Grimmsnarl Prankster screens (+1 priority). Sinistcha TR at -7 priority can be stopped by Prankster Taunt. Pelipper Hurricane 100% acc in rain, 31-57% on Grimmsnarl. Plan: Fake Out T1, screens T2, Archaludon sweep; Staraptor for Sneasler revenge. Game 1 lead: Politoed+Grimmsnarl, Archaludon+Staraptor back.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler Protect denies Grimmsnarl FakeOut (priority +3) and preserves Sneasler at 100% so it can CC next turn for the White Herb→Unburden +1 Spe boost. Pelipper Hydro Pump on Politoed leverages rain (+50% Water) for 82.5 effective BP at 80% acc, pressuring the opposing rain setter; even if Politoed survives via Sitrus, chip accumulation matters. Pelipper bulk (120/90) absorbs one Politoed hit. Rain war already won (8t vs 5t).
decisions.notebook: Opp team: Politoed Drizzle 5t rain, Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb weak to Fighting, Noivern Infiltrator ExpertBelt 157-192 Spe, Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay screens FakeOut, Staraptor Intimidate Sash 132-167 Spe, Garganacl PurifyingSalt WideGuard. decisions.rationale: Prankster Reflect goes up before Sneasler moves, cutting Close Combat to ~26-74%. Weather Ball in rain (100 BP Water, STAB+rain boost) does 43-99% to Sneasler—massive chip or near-KO. Even if Grimmsnarl takes Hurricane+CC through Reflect, Sneasler is in Staraptor Brave Bird KO range next turn. Sneasler Protect has reduced odds after T1.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant), Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(Mega Launcher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key: Manectric LRod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—KO/force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Sneasler CC triggers WhiteHerb->Unburden (280-344 Spe), outspeeds everything. Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOs Sneasler. Politoed Weather Ball in rain = 100 BP Water STAB+rain, 43-99% on Sneasler. Houndoom Taunt outsped by Prankster screens. Sinistcha TR at -7 stopped by Prankster Taunt. Plan: Fake Out T1, screens T2, Archaludon sweep; Staraptor for Sneasler revenge. Game 1 lead: Politoed+Grimmsnarl, Archaludon+Staraptor back. Next turn: bring Staraptor to Brave Bird weakened Sneasler, or Archaludon if Sneasler already KO'd.

decisions.rationale: Double target Politoed to remove their Drizzle source. Hurricane (110 BP Flying STAB, neutral on Water) has higher expected damage than Hydro Pump (resisted 0.5x): 165*0.7=115.5 vs 123.75*0.8=99. Close Combat (120 BP Fighting STAB, neutral) adds 180 effective BP. Combined ~95-125% should KO Politoed from 69%, ending their 5-turn rain while my 7-turn DampRock rain continues. Even if Grimmsnarl lands Reflect (halves CC) or Light Screen (halves Hurricane), combined ~65-85% still has strong KO chanc
decisions.notebook: Opp team confirmed: Politoed Drizzle 5t rain, Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay FakeOut screens, Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb weak to Fighting, Noivern Infiltrator ExpertBelt 157-192 Spe, Staraptor Intimidate Sash 132-167 Spe, Garganacl PurifyingSalt WideGuard. selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Politoed)
decisions.rationale: Politoed at 7% switches to Archaludon which walls Sneasler (Poison Jab immune, Rock Slide NVE, CC neutral+Reflect). Light Screen completes dual-screen protection so Archaludon survives double-targeting (47-101% with both screens vs 56-136% without). Next turn Flash Cannon easily KOs 15% Sneasler (33-74% of max HP) with no SpA drop if Protect-blocked. Keeps Archaludon healthy for sweep; Grimmsnarl retains Prankster Taunt for Sinistcha TR later.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant), Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key: Manectric LRod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—KO/force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Sneasler CC triggers WhiteHerb->Unburden (280-344 Spe), outspeeds everything. Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOs Sneasler. Archaludon walls Sneasler: Poison Jab immune (Steel), Rock Slide NVE (Dragon resists), CC neutral (Steel weak/Dragon resist cancels) halved by Reflect. Flash Cannon neutral into Sneasler (33-74% max HP) KOs at 15%. Pelipper Hydro Pump NVE vs Archaludon (Water/Dragon 0.5x). Houndoom Taunt outsped by Prankster screens. Sinistcha TR at -7 stopped by Prankster Taunt. Plan: dual screens + Archaludon sweep; Staraptor for Sneasler revenge or Final Gambit. Game 1 lead: Politoed+Grimmsnarl, Archaludon+Staraptor back.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler at 16% HP is fragile; Protect (+4 priority) blocks Grimmsnarl's Fake Out (+3) and any switch-in hit, guaranteeing survival. Pelipper Hydro Pump in rain (165BP effective) KOs Politoed at 7% HP despite Water-on-Water NVE, removing their Drizzle source while my DampRock continues rain for 6 more turns. Grimmsnarl's only damaging move is Fake Out (blocked), so Sneasler is completely safe. Positions me with rain advantage, Sneasler alive for Archaludon answer next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opp team: Politoed Drizzle 5t rain, Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay FakeOut screens (no real attacks besides FakeOut), Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb weak to Fighting, Noivern Infiltrator ExpertBelt 157-192 Spe, Staraptor Intimidate Sash 132-167 Spe, Garganacl PurifyingSalt WideGuard. Rain war won via DampRock 8t vs Politoed 5t. Archaludon is biggest threat - Sneasler CC answers despite Stamina Def boosts. Noivern outspeeds Sneasler/Houndoom base - Manectric Scarf is the check. Staraptor Intimidate weakens Sneasler but FocusSash means it dies to one hit. Garganacl PurifyingSalt ignores Ghost/status. Mega Blastoise cleans late with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher boost. Grimmsnarl is support-only, safe to ignore offensively.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler outspeeds all (280-344) and CC alone does 37-65% after Reflect—right at Archaludon's 65% HP. If Pelipper also targets Archaludon (Hydro Pump 17-31% after Light Screen), combined 54-96% likely KOs my sweeper. Protect guarantees survival; Taunt locks Pelipper out of Protect. Next turn Flash Cannon KOs Sneasler (33% min > 15% HP), then Electro Shot KOs Pelipper (4x SE). Grimmsnarl tanks any redirected hit at 100% behind screens.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant), Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key: Manectric LRod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—KO/force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Sneasler Unburden (280-344 Spe) outspeeds everything; CC does 37-65% to Archaludon after Reflect at +1 Def. Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOs Sneasler. Archaludon Flash Cannon KOs Sneasler at 15% (33% min). Pelipper Hydro Pump NVE vs Archaludon but rain-boosted; combined with CC can KO. Houndoom Taunt outsped by Prankster screens. Sinistcha TR at -7 stopped by Prankster Taunt. Plan: dual screens + Archaludon sweep; Staraptor for Sneasler revenge or Final Gambit. Game 1 lead: Politoed+Grimmsnarl, Archaludon+Staraptor back. Turn 4 plan: Protect Archaludon from double-target, Taunt Pelipper; turn 5 Flash Cannon Sneasler KO, turn 6 Electro Shot Pelipper KO.

decisions.rationale: Trade Sneasler for Archaludon damage. Sneasler at 16% will die to any hit; better to cash it in now. Sneasler CC (2x SE) + Pelipper rain Hydro Pump should KO or leave Archaludon at 0-20%, removing opponent's biggest threat. Pelipper maintains rain (critical since Politoed at 7%). Even if Archaludon Draco Meteors back, the trade is worth it.
decisions.notebook: Rain war won: Damp Rock 8t vs Politoed 5t. Politoed at 7% will die soon. Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb is biggest threat, 2x weak to Fighting. Sneasler Unburden x2 Spe (344) is key but fragile. Manectric Scarf 172 Spe checks Noivern (157-192) and Staraptor (132-167). Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay is support-only, safe to ignore offensively. Garganacl PurifyingSalt ignores status. Mega Blastoise cleans late with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher. Screens (Reflect 6t, Light Screen 7t) extended by LightClay.

decisions.rationale: Flash Cannon KOs Sneasler at 15% (39% min with LO > 15% HP). Archaludon likely survives double-target: CC ~21-44% after Reflect+Def boost, Hydro Pump ~13-32% after Light Screen, total ~34-76% vs 65% HP. Reflect refresh extends physical screen for sweep. Pelipper Taunted so cannot Protect. Next turn Electro Shot 4x KOs Pelipper. Keeping Grimmsnarl preserves Prankster Taunt for Sinistcha TR.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant), Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key: Manectric LRod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—KO/force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Sneasler Unburden (280-344 Spe) outspeeds everything; CC does ~21-44% to Archaludon after Reflect at +1 Def. Staraptor Brave Bird OHKOs Sneasler. Archaludon Flash Cannon KOs Sneasler at 15%. Pelipper Hydro Pump NVE vs Archaludon but rain-boosted; combined with CC can KO at high rolls. Houndoom Taunt outsped by Prankster screens. Sinistcha TR stopped by Prankster Taunt. Pelipper Taunted turn 4, cannot use status moves (including Protect). Plan: dual screens + Archaludon sweep; Staraptor for Sneasler revenge or Final Gambit. Turn 5: Flash Cannon KOs Sneasler, Reflect refresh. Turn 6: Electro Shot KOs Pelipper. Watch for Manectric switch-in to block Electro Shot with LightningRod.

decisions.rationale: Sneasler at 344 Spe moves first; Close Combat does 62.9-109.1% to Archaludon (likely KO or leaves at ~2%). Hydro Pump rain-boosted does 32.5-63%. Combined damage guarantees Archaludon faint. Even if Pelipper faints to Electro Shot (4x SE), we trade Pelipper+Sneasler for their win-con Archaludon. Sneasler at 16% was dying soon anyway. Removing Stamina LifeOrb Archaludon opens the late game for Manectric Scarf and Mega Blastoise rain cleanup.
decisions.notebook: Rain war won: Damp Rock 8t vs Politoed 5t. Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb is biggest threat, 2x weak to Fighting. Sneasler Unburden x2 (344 Spe) is key but fragile. Manectric Scarf 172 Spe checks Noivern (157-192) and Staraptor (132-167). Grimmsnarl Prankster LightClay is support-only, safe to ignore offensively. Garganacl PurifyingSalt ignores status. Mega Blastoise cleans late with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher. Screens (Reflect/Light Screen) extended by LightClay. Politoed at 7% will die soon. After Archaludon falls, pivot to Manectric + Mega Blastoise endgame.

decisions.rationale: Manectric with Lightning Rod is the optimal switch-in: it redirects Archaludon's 4x SE Electro Shot away from low-HP Taunted Pelipper, gains +1 SpAtk from the absorbed hit, and Choice Scarf 258 Spe lets it revenge KO the 13% Archaludon or pivot with Volt Switch. Houndoom lacks redirect and Fire is resisted by Archaludon's Steel typing.
decisions.notebook: Rain war won (Damp Rock 8t vs Politoed 5t). Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb at 13% is the win condition blocker. Manectric Scarf + Lightning Rod is the Archaludon answer and Noivern/Staraptor check. Screens extended by LightClay. Politoed at 7% near death. After Archaludon falls, pivot Manectric + Mega Blastoise endgame with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher.

decisions.rationale: Manectric outspeeds and can KO Archaludon at 13% through Light Screen. Protect guarantees survival and scouts Manectric's Choice lock. Taunt on Manectric blocks Volt Switch and Protect, forcing an attack into Protect that locks its Scarf. Next turn we exploit the lock. Draco Meteor is too risky—Manectric acts first and Archaludon dies to Life Orb anyway.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant)FNT, Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key: Manectric LRod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—must KO/force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Manectric Scarf 205-258 Spe outspeeds all our mons. Staraptor Final Gambit needs full HP to KO but Manectric outspeeds and breaks Sash first. Grimmsnarl has NO damaging moves—pure support. Archaludon at low HP with Life Orb gets 1-2 attacks max before recoil death. Plan: Protect this turn to lock Manectric's Scarf via Taunt+Protect, then exploit lock next turn. If Manectric locked into Thunderbolt, can cycle switches to waste its PP. Win condition likely Staraptor Brave Bird/Close Combat cleanup after Manectric is dealt with. Pelipper Taunt applied turn 4, should last through turn 7.

decisions.rationale: Archaludon at 13% is the win-con blocker. Pelipper Ice Beam is 4x SE on Dragon/Steel and OHKOs through Light Screen at this HP. Manectric Thunderbolt adds STAB damage to guarantee the KO before Archaludon can Draco Meteor our 46% Pelipper. Lightning Rod already covers Electro Shot redirection. Rain has 3 turns left—keep Pelipper in to preserve it for the Blastoise endgame.
decisions.notebook: Rain war won (Damp Rock 8t vs Politoed 5t). Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb is the win-con blocker—must KO before it stacks more Def boosts. Manectric Scarf + Lightning Rod is the Archaludon answer and Noivern/Staraptor check. Screens extended by LightClay. Politoed at 7% near death. After Archaludon falls, pivot Manectric + Mega Blastoise endgame with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher. Pelipper is Taunted so no Protect—fragile at 46%. Grimmsnarl Prankster can still Taunt/Fake Out but PP limited.

selection: Light Screen (your side, including ally Archaludon)
decisions.rationale: Draco Meteor targets Manectric (85.9-209.7%, likely OHKO on frail Scarf Timid) to remove LightningRod+Speed threat blocking Staraptor's sweep. Archaludon outspeeds Pelipper (123>117) so attack lands first. Life Orb leaves Archaludon at 3%, likely dying to Ice Beam — but trading Archaludon for Manectric is optimal since Archaludon is at 13% anyway. Light Screen refreshes to 7 turns for Staraptor. 90% acc is main risk; nothing on foe team resists Dragon so switch-ins eat heavy neutral damage.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant)FNT, Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Key: Manectric LRod redirects Archaludon Electro Shot—must KO/force out Manectric before Archaludon sweeps. Manectric Scarf 205-258 Spe outspeeds all our mons incl Staraptor 151. Staraptor Final Gambit needs full HP to KO but Manectric outspeeds and breaks Sash first. Grimmsnarl has NO damaging moves—pure support. Archaludon at low HP with Life Orb gets 1-2 attacks max before recoil death. Win condition: Staraptor Brave Bird/Close Combat cleanup after Manectric removed. Staraptor outspeeds Pelipper/Blastoise/Sinistcha; Houndoom 126-161 may outspeed 151. Close Combat SE vs Houndoom, Brave Bird SE vs Sinistcha. Nothing on foe team resists Dragon.

decisions.rationale: Politoed at 7% is expendable. Bringing Staraptor into Manectric's Choice-locked Thunderbolt (2x SE vs Flying) breaks Focus Sash, and Pelipper Ice Beam (2x SE) likely KOs it next — losing our only win condition. Sacrifice Politoed to absorb Thunderbolt, preserve Staraptor at 100%+Sash for a safer entry once Manectric is forced out or dealt with. Grimmsnarl has only Pass available.
decisions.notebook: Opponent team: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler(Unburden/WhiteHerb/Adamant)FNT, Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid/Choice-locked Thunderbolt), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Manectric Scarf 205-258 Spe outspeeds all our mons incl Staraptor 151. Staraptor Final Gambit needs full HP but Manectric outspeeds and breaks Sash first. Grimmsnarl pure support—no damaging moves. Win condition: Staraptor Brave Bird/Close Combat cleanup after Manectric removed. Staraptor outspeeds Pelipper/Blastoise/Sinistcha; Houndoom 126-161 may outspeed 151. Close Combat SE vs Houndoom, Brave Bird SE vs Sinistcha. Nothing on foe team resists Dragon. Manectric LightningRod redirects Electric attacks—must KO/force out Manectric before any Electric move user can sweep. Manectric currently Taunted (expires soon). Screens expire in 3-4 turns.

decisions.rationale: Manectric outspeeds everything (258) T-bolts Archaludon. Archaludon at 13% even 0.5x should KO without Protect. Pelipper Ice Beam is 2x SE on Dragon, adds pressure. Pelipper is Taunted, can't Protect; staying and hitting Arch is best. If Arch Protects Manectric, Pelipper's 2x SE Ice Beam may KO from 13%. If Arch Protects Pelipper, Manectric's T-bolt still hits.
decisions.notebook: Rain war won 8t vs 5t. Screens extended by LightClay 4t/3t. Politoed near death. Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb is the win-con blocker at +2 Def - must KO turn 7. Manectric Scarf + Lightning Rod is the Arch answer and Noivern/Staraptor check. After Arch falls, pivot to Mega Blastoise endgame with rain Hydro Pump + Mega Launcher. Grimmsnarl Prankster Taunt/Fake Out PP nearly exhausted. Pelipper Taunted fragile at 46%.

decisions.rationale: Politoed at 7% is dead to Manectric Thunderbolt (outspeeds). Switching to Staraptor brings it in under Light Screen + Focus Sash, guaranteeing survival. Intimidate is a free bonus. Grimmsnarl can't refresh screens (would fail), so Taunt Pelipper prevents Protect, enabling next-turn Staraptor Close Combat or Brave Bird without prediction games. This preserves 3 mons and advances the win condition.
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler FNT, Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid/Choice-locked TBolt), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Manectric Scarf 205-258 Spe outspeeds Staraptor 151. Screens cannot be refreshed while active (Reflect/Light Screen fail if already up). Grimmsnarl has no damaging moves—pure support. Staraptor Final Gambit needs full HP but Manectric outspeeds and breaks Sash first. Win con: Staraptor cleanup after Manectric removed. Close Combat SE vs Houndoom, Brave Bird SE vs Sinistcha. Nothing on foe team resists Dragon (Archaludon now fainted). Down 3-5, must preserve Staraptor.

decisions.rationale: Manectric is Choice-locked into Tbolt and Taunted (can't switch). Politoed at 7% HP dies to SE 2x Tbolt through Light Screen regardless of rain. Pelipper at 46% is fragile and Grimmsnarl likely Fakes Out or Taunts; Protect guarantees survival and blocks Taunt so Pelipper keeps Protect option next turn. If Politoed Protects, Tbolt is blocked but rain ends next turn anyway and Polipper can be KO'd then. Double-targeting Politoed wastes Pelipper's turn if Protect goes up.
decisions.notebook: Rain war won 8t vs 5t. Screens extended by LightClay 4t/3t. Archaludon Stamina LifeOrb KO'd turn 7 by Manectric Scarf Tbolt. Politoed near death at 7%. Manectric Scarf + Lightning Rod is the Arch answer and Noivern/Staraptor check. Grimmsnarl Prankster Taunt/Fake Out PP nearly exhausted. Pelipper Taunt expired, fragile at 46%. After Politoed falls, rain ends and pivot to non-rain endgame with Houndoom (Flash Fire) and Manectric. Noivern Infiltrator bypasses screens but I have none up. Staraptor Focus Sash Intimidate is a threat on switch. Garganacl Purifying Salt walls status.

decisions.rationale: Manectric outspeeds (205-258) and Thunderbolt KOs Staraptor at 21% even through Light Screen (~50-74% vs 21% HP). Protect is mandatory to survive. Grimmsnarl Taunts Pelipper to deny Protect next turn—if Manectric switches out of Choice lock, Staraptor can Brave Bird Pelipper for potential KO. Grimmsnarl stays to refresh screens later.
decisions.notebook: Opponent: Pelipper(Drizzle/DampRock/Modest), Houndoom(FlashFire/Sitrus/Timid/Taunt), Sneasler FNT, Manectric(LightningRod/Scarf/Timid/Choice-locked TBolt), Blastoise-Mega(MegaLauncher/Modest), Sinistcha(Hospitality/Leftovers/Sassy/TR). Manectric Scarf 205-258 Spe outspeeds Staraptor 151. Thunderbolt KOs Staraptor at 21% even through Light Screen. Grimmsnarl pure support (no damaging moves). Screens cannot refresh while active. Win con requires Manectric removed or Choice-locked into non-Thunderbolt. Brave Bird can KO Pelipper at 45% (44-82% range). Close Combat SE vs Houndoom, Brave Bird SE vs Sinistcha. Down 3-5, must preserve Staraptor. Game likely lost if Manectric stays in and keeps targeting Staraptor.
